target: Peak Flood Level (m) >= gauge-specific Danger Level
interpretation: Danger-level exceedance among already-recorded flood events only; not flood occurrence probability.

dataset.name: INDOFLOODS event, precipitation, metadata and catchment tables

validation.method: One deterministic 75/25 GroupShuffleSplit by gauge; test gauges are unseen in training.

features: T1d through T10d cumulative event precipitation
catchment land-cover, soil and lithology categories
limitations: The data contains flood events but not matched non-flood periods; the model cannot learn whether/when a flood will occur.
The dataset covers Indian gauges, not a Kochi-only sample; this does not establish Kochi/Ernakulam validity.
Only one grouped holdout split was evaluated; repeated grouped validation, uncertainty intervals, calibration and external validation remain outstanding.
Not approved for operational warning or public safety decisions.
data_quality_note: Of 4548 event rows, 4451 could be joined to gauge danger-level metadata; 97 lacked a danger level and were excluded from this training target.
